profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II - iOS at Nordstrom
profile.summary:
North Carolina State University Cum Laude graduate of May 2013 with a B.S. in Computer Science with a Concentration in Game Development. 

I'm a big fan of mobile app development and I have iOS/Android/PhoneGap work experience. Other technologies that I've worked with in school and work are Java, C, Objective C, MySQL, Javascript, jQuery, HTML5, LaTeX, assembly x86, and Unity (Scripting in Javascript and C#).

I'm also interested in game development/design that I currently make small mini game projects on the side in Unity.  I work on these side projects to help facilitate the Video Game Development Club at North Carolina State University by showing current students the potential of making creative and unique games in Unity.  Even though I graduated already, I go back to help the club that I helped founded out!

I'm a very good leader and a hard worker who takes every task given seriously.  I'm very energetic and always put my work first.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Built from the ground up the Microtransit app for iOS and Android with my team mates along with maintenance and new features to the OnDemand Driver iPad app. Did unit testing and UI automation testing on all of these applications. Used reactive programming with RxSwift, RxJava, RxCocoa, RxKotlin and used a MVP and VIPER architectures. Frequently did pair programming through out role.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description: Digital product agency where I work on various iOS and Android applications.  Created apps from the ground up but also jumped into other application's code and added new features, fixed bugs, etc. New apps are built in Swift, while older projects are a mix of Objective-C and Swift.

positions.title: Lead Mobile Developer
positions.description: Working on Shoeboxed's Android and iPhone apps! My position involves implementing new features in both apps using native Objective-C/Java code for iOS/Android.  I mention using native code because we are using Cordova/Phonegap for both mobile apps, so most of the code is html, but I touch most the native side with some html work.  On the web side I've used jQuery mobile, backbones.js, mustache, and javascript.  I also do maintenance (fixing bugs/issues, updating libraries, etc.) on both apps. Later on, I took the iOS app and made it native while continuing to maintain the Android app in Cordova.

positions.title: iOS Intern
positions.description: Worked on new features of Joulebug's iOS app!

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked on various IT services, such as upgrading RAM/graphics cards in various computers, etc.

positions.title: Recruiting Intern
positions.description: Viewed resumes online via CareerBuilder, Monster, Dice, etc. to find potential candidates to fill positions.  Plus various IT work.

projects.title: Shoeboxed iOS 7 Native App
projects.description:
Created new native app from scratch strictly for iOS 7+
 
RestKit 0.22.0 (includes AFNetworking)
UserVoice SDK
UrbanAirship
SVWebViewController
ECSlidingViewController
Appirater
Harpy

- App now syncs data from your Shoeboxed account via Shoeboxed's API v2 (old app used API v1)
- Ability to handle different document types (Business card, other, and receipt, old app only receipts)
- Uses new iOS 7 APIs (such as MKDirections, etc.)
- Ability to edit document data in-app
- Seamless core data synchronization (solves updating data conflicts, retrying upload errors, etc.)
- Background image processing

projects.title: Propaganda
projects.description:
Creating a game based on constraints given by professor: restricted point of view, one shot one kill, theme has to be political/intrigue. Creating a 2.5D side scrolling stealth game with a group of designers/developers.  

Personally worked on gameplay programming that included: snapshot feature and hiding against/in various objects (sewer, air ducts, tables, etc.).  Worked on implementing animations through mechanim, including animation state machines to transition between animations correctly. Contributed in multiple game design ideas through out the project including puzzles, running mechanics, game flow, etc.
